title: Existence and uniqueness of the trace of a finite etale morphism
statement: For every finite etale morphism of schemes $f:Y\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and every abelian sheaf $F$ on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] there is a morphism of abelian sheaves $\operatorname{tr}_{f,F}:f_*f^{-1}F\to F$ (direct and inverse image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]), and the family of these morphisms is the unique one with the following properties: (0) $\operatorname{tr}_{f,F}$ is natural in $F$; (1) it commutes with etale localization on $X$: for every etale $g:X'\to X$, with $f':Y'=Y\times_XX'\to X'$ the base change and $g':Y'\to Y$ the projection, the restriction $g^{-1}\operatorname{tr}_{f,F}$ equals $\operatorname{tr}_{f',g^{-1}F}$ under the canonical identifications $g^{-1}f_*f^{-1}F=f'_*f'^{-1}g^{-1}F$ (for $g$ etale, $g^{-1}$ is restriction to $X'_{\Et}$, and both sides send an etale $W\to X'$ to $(f^{-1}F)(W\times_XY)=(f'^{-1}g^{-1}F)(W\times_{X'}Y')$); (2) if $Y=\coprod_{i=1}^dX$ ($d\ge0$) and $f$ is the identity on each summand, then under $f_*f^{-1}F=F^{\oplus d}$ (sections over $W$: $(f^{-1}F)(\coprod_{i=1}^dW)=F(W)^{d}$) the map $\operatorname{tr}_{f,F}$ is the sum map $F^{\oplus d}\to F$.
